hero.title: Project management that keeps your team moving
hero.subtitle: Trestle brings tasks, projects, and collaboration into one fast, focused workspace — built for teams who ship.

tasks.title: Every task, exactly where it belongs
tasks.description: Create, assign, and prioritize tasks in seconds. Due dates, priorities, and statuses keep everyone aligned without extra meetings.

projects.title: Structure work your way
projects.description: Group tasks into projects with progress tracking built in. Switch between board and list views without losing context.

boards.title: Visualize progress at a glance
boards.description: Kanban boards that update in real time as work moves forward. Drag, drop, done.

collaboration.title: Comment, mention, and stay in sync
collaboration.description: Discuss work directly on the task. No more digging through chat threads to find context.

whyTrestle.title: Why teams choose Trestle
whyTrestle.description: Most project tools force a tradeoff between power and speed. Trestle keeps the essentials — tasks, projects, boards, comments — fast and uncluttered, so your team spends time doing the work, not managing the tool.

pricing.title: Simple, transparent pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start free. Upgrade when your team grows.

items.a: Yes. The Free plan supports up to 3 projects with unlimited tasks — no credit card required.

items.q: Can I switch between board and list views?
items.a: Every project supports both board and list views, and you can switch anytime without losing data.
Pro and Enterprise plans include integrations with common developer and communication tools.
Yes, Pro plans are billed monthly and can be cancelled at any time from your account settings.
